test_simple_client: test the simple_client python module by running it with a server address and screenshot path via argparse CLI
run_main_client: run the main function of simple_client to send a screenshot to a pix2act model server and print the beam result
create_stub_connection: create a gRPC stub connection to a pix2act model server using client_utils.get_stub with a server BNS
get_model_beam: get a single beam search result from the pix2act model server by passing a PNG screenshot via client_utils.get_single_beam
convert_beam_to_string: convert a beam search result to a human-readable string using client_utils.beam_to_str
